question: What must be placed in the center after drawing the six-cornered figure?
premises: A six-cornered figure is drawn first.
The kāma seed-syllable is placed in its middle.
inference: After drawing the six-cornered figure, one places the kāma seed-syllable in its center.
plain_english: First, having drawn a six-cornered figure, place the kāma seed-syllable in its middle.
